description: Metadata for confirmed public AI Now Institute HTML pages on ainowinstitute.org. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. The catalog stores the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies and PDFs are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Rights is creative_commons only when the page states CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA and does not also state a restricted deed. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND stay unknown. A public page, a copyright notice, or a terms link is not a licence. News posts, contributor profiles, and shop pages are not listed. runner_wired is false.
